Template and copy changes need her sign-off before merge.","criticality":0.5,"epistemic":"fact","id":"01a106ba-ed9a-7551-9eab-7bcdb1329eaf","invalidated_at":"2026-10-04T11:44:40.442821104Z","logical":["notifier"],"physical":["services/notifier/"],"provenance":"human","status":"challenged","summary":"Who owns the notifier","superseded_by":"01a106ba-fcd9-7342-9134-8fcb35bdb569","tags":["notifier","ownership"],"type":"context","visibility":"shared"}}

The Growth team signs off. Post the change in **#growth-eng**, and any Growth engineer can approve it. They've owned the notifier since 2026-09-01.

You might hear that Dana Okafor has to approve notifier copy. That was the rule before, but she has moved to Platform. Our project notes still had an older entry saying she must sign off on template and copy changes, so I flagged it as outdated and pointed it to the current one. I found no CODEOWNERS file in the repo, so nothing there enforces either rule.

When you change the wording, the receipt template in `services/notifier/templates/` comes as a pair: an `.mjml` file and a plain-text `.txt` copy. Update both and keep the same variables in each. The plain-text copy matters because some corporate mail gateways strip HTML.
